holiday_calendar_assignments.note: Same regional calendar as Pune HQ, but higher priority lets night-shift group override future date-boundary rules independently if needed.

_field_notes.scope: WORK_LOCATION | DEPARTMENT | SHIFT_GROUP for holiday calendars. EMPLOYEE_CATEGORY | GRADE | DEPARTMENT for leave policies. This is the ONLY layer that changes when onboarding a new office/shift group.
_field_notes.priority: If an employee matches more than one assignment rule (e.g. belongs to both a WORK_LOCATION rule and a SHIFT_GROUP rule), the resolver picks the highest priority number. Lets a shift-group-specific override win over the location default.
_field_notes.resolution_order: Employee -> ShiftAssignment.shift_group_id -> match SHIFT_GROUP rule if exists, else -> Employee.work_location_id -> match WORK_LOCATION rule. Same pattern for department fallback if neither matches (not seeded here, but structurally supported).
